mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for a garage conversion consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a remodeling contractor, clarify your primary use for the space, locate your electrical panel, and determine your storage strategy. Decide whether the suite will house an aging parent, an adult child, or serve as a guest studio, as accessibility needs like walk-in showers impact the floor plan. Check where your home's main sewer line and electrical service enter the property, and take note of where outdoor equipment, lawn tools, and laundry units will move once vehicle space is gone. Having these details ready helps establish realistic estimates and layouts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Determine your target layout and intended use, locate your electrical panel and main sewer line, and decide how you will handle lost vehicle and utility storage.
